name: Check serverless API graph
description: Manually runs `npm run check:api` on demand to verify the Vercel serverless function graph resolves under real Node ESM rules (nodenext type-check plus a (req, res) import smoke test). This hook is user-triggered only: it fires solely when you click its button in the Kiro Agent Hooks panel. It has no automatic trigger, so it never runs on its own or consumes credits unattended.

then.prompt: Run `npm run check:api` from the workspace root and report whether it passed or failed, including the first error if it failed. Do not modify any files.
